name: B10-0147/2025 (Verts/ALE) – White paper on the future of European defence
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for a major boost to European defence. It wants more weapons and money for Ukraine, faster joint production of military equipment across EU countries, and less reliance on the United States. It asks for common European forces, shared air defence and cyber defence, and a single market for defence products. It also wants stronger democratic oversight and new ways to fund all of this. This is a set of demands, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to include these ideas in its defence white paper.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, defence companies, small firms and start-ups, and Ukraine.
- **What happens next:** The Commission drafts the white paper; Parliament pushes to shape it.
